learning_objective: 🎯 Today we will learn how to make new friends with the magical little words 'A' and 'An'!
warm_up_hook: 📖 Hello little friend! Did you know that the alphabet letters have a secret club? Some letters are very special and need a magic word before their names. Let us find out what it is!

lesson_modules.teaching_content: In our alphabet family, there are five special friends. They are a, e, i, o, and u. We call them Vowels! They make beautiful and soft sounds.
When a word starts with a special vowel sound, it feels lonely. So, we give it a buddy called 'An'. If a word starts with a, e, i, o, or u, we say 'An' before it!
All the other letters in the alphabet are called Consonants. They are very strong! They just need a small buddy called 'A' before their names.

practice_quiz.question: ❓ What do we say before the word 'apple'?
❓ What do we say before the word 'dog'?

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The 'A' and 'An' Toy Basket Game
fun_activity.instructions: Take a small basket. Pick up your toys one by one. If the toy's name starts with a vowel (like an aeroplane), say 'An'. If it starts with a consonant (like a car), say 'A'!

chapter_summary: ⭐ The five special vowels are a, e, i, o, and u.
⭐ We use 'An' before words that start with a vowel sound.
⭐ We use 'A' before all the other words!
